generation.mode: built-in imagegen edit with edit-target.png first and L2-seed-region-r2-source.png second as reference only

lighting_isotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by uniform-bin mean after a local separable Lanczos3 reproduction at the 2560 px shipped canvas; water-mask pixels and gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lighting_isotropy.visual_check: The aggregate proxies clear the measured threshold, but multiple painted boulders retain visibly lighter upper facets and darker lower facets; the strict no-lit-side rule is not claimed.

median_conifer_crown_final_scale.measurement: Manual median of the five complete discernible crowns in the overlapping sheltered cluster; crowns cut by the right frame edge were excluded because their complete width is not visible. Diagnostic crops are under diagnostics/.

buildable_vs_steep_fraction.basis: manual estimated fraction of non-water land area
buildable_vs_steep_fraction.method: The broad gently sloping inland ground counts as buildable; only the immediate shore banks and small hollow banks count as steep; shingle, exposed rock, heather, and the sheltered conifer hollow make up the remainder.

water_mask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
water_mask.derivation: Source-raster hue, saturation, luminance, and wet-margin classification constrained by broad coast and inland-hydrology search envelopes, followed by source-pixel connectivity, local closure, and enclosed-hole filling. The final boundary follows painted wet pixels; no polyline supplies it.

final_canvas_gate_reproduction.note: Node is not present in this managed PowerShell environment, so the repository formula was reproduced locally at the actual 2560 px final scale.

open_risks: Hard lighting rule: several boulders have visibly lighter upper facets and darker lower facets despite the low aggregate directional-light proxy; strict neutral lighting is not established.
Hard rock-language rule: much of the land is rendered as dense small faceted stones with visible top faces rather than predominantly smooth, low, rounded basalt with face-free values.
Biome transition: gold-green meadow remains visually dominant well beyond the arriving neighbour tone instead of resolving into the requested austere grey-rock, pale-sand, thin-olive sound coast.
Scale rule: the five complete sheltered-hollow crowns measure in range, but crowns intersecting the right frame edge cannot be measured at full width, so the all-crowns minimum is not established.
The inland hydrology is mechanically one closed beck-and-pool component, but its trailing channel can read as an outlet rather than a beck simply ending in the pool.
Seam continuity, exact wet-pixel boundary judgment, and overall visual quality remain director and owner decisions; this report does not claim visual acceptance.
